method: Actual Figma reactions read back through Plugin API, interpreted locally; no browser playback or backend calls.

checks.name: arbitrary six-hero roster is copied once into a battle snapshot
maneuver and selected target survive individual confirmation
Defense is saved without an enemy target
Special availability follows the selected fighter
all three choices must be saved before submission; wait resolves to team reveal
1×1 supports a different hero and preserves the unique maneuver
collect grants once and repeat taps show the empty state
all internal destinations exist on the unified page
every state has a return route or an intentional external exit
35 original cues have matching hashes, positive durations and peak headroom
